location.name: The Whispering Cave Entrance
location.description: You stand at the mouth of a dark, moss-covered cave. A steady drip of water echoes from within, and a cool, damp breeze carries the scent of earth and something faintly... magical. A cascading waterfall to your right partially conceals the entrance, its roar a constant presence.

waterfall.description: A powerful waterfall crashes down into a shallow pool, obscuring the cave entrance. The water is crystal clear and cold.

cave_entrance.description: A dark opening in the rock face, partially hidden by the waterfall.
